in_telugu.name: నలినీయ

in_marathi.name: Naliniya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Naliniya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from Sanskrit 'nalina' meaning 'lotus'. Represents beauty, grace, and spiritual growth.

in_bengali.name: Naliniya
in_bengali.long_meaning: Naliniya একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from Sanskrit 'nalina' meaning 'lotus'. Represents beauty, grace, and spiritual growth.
